long_biography.plain_text:
Antar’s operating model has repeatedly combined security hardware, software and services around specific institutional problems. A+ began as a home-based reseller, then grew into a systems integrator spanning surveillance, access control, audio-video and IT infrastructure. IPVideo moved further into proprietary products: its HALO device detected vaping, air-quality risks, abnormal sound and other threats in spaces where cameras were unsuitable.

Strategic buyers supplied the commercial payoff. Motorola Solutions bought IPVideo in 2023, after which Antar led the acquired product division for the following year; Convergint acquired A+ in 2025. He has since remained active as ViewScan’s president and A+ STEM Labs’ chairman, applying artificial intelligence to remote guarding while keeping educational technology as another part of his portfolio. Neither buyer disclosed his personal proceeds, and the value of his current interests remains private.
